svg.title: "Delete Alice's email" with two tool lists. Without a delete tool (list, search, mark read, send), the AI finds the email, then says "I can't delete emails" and offers to mark it read or reply. With a delete tool added, it searches and deletes: "Done — I found and deleted the email." The list of tools is the list of things the agent can do.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
